content-max-width.$description: New token (2026-09-19), added for EmptyState's own description text — a width cap so a centred message keeps a comfortable line length (roughly 45-75 characters) inside a wide container such as a full page or a wide table cell, instead of stretching across it. No home on any existing primitive scale: the spacing scale tops out at 8rem, and this is a content-measure constraint rather than a gap or padding.
